verdict.rationale: Cline uses external tools through MCP servers, which users can add and manage. Auto Approve lets users choose which actions, including MCP tools, run without prompting, and every other action needs explicit human approval. This gives per-session control over tool access. It is not shown to be an enforceable policy an engineering lead can set for a team. Missing for 10: team or org-level allowlists/denylists for MCP servers and integrations, centrally enforced policy that stops users enabling YOLO mode, per-tool permission docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
